'''Meltch Krakko''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] member who was once an instructor at the [[Orsis Academy]], before he left to return to his clan. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], under his guise of Darth Sidious, managed to persuade Krakko to return to the Academy to help hone a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] combat skills. After discovering that Maul was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] during a brutal training session, Krakko hatched a plan to get Maul captured by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and possibly killed. Maul survived all attempts, and returned to kill everyone in Orsis Academy per Sidious's orders. Upon arriving at Headmaster [[Trezza]]'s office covered in blood, he dodged all of Krakko's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, and grasped the Mandalorian by the throat with his bare hands, breaking his neck and throwing his dead body into the fireplace.

==Talents and abilities==
[[File:QuiGonDarthMaul2.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Krakko served as Maul (pictured) combat instructor.]]
Meltch Krakko wore familiar gray Mandalorian [[battle armor]] and was known to have fought [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]; highly skilled to the point that Sidious described him as the best. Meltch was able to knock a young Maul unconscious with one punch, yet fell easily to a young Maul's determined rage a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.
